title: Llama in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#f2d59b'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='35' y='78' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e0b978'/>
  <rect x='45' y='80' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#f2d59b'/>
  <rect x='56' y='80' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#f2d59b'/>
  <rect x='66' y='78' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e0b978'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='42' y='38' width='12' height='24' rx='6' fill='#f2d59b'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='32' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#f2d59b'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='20' rx='3' ry='7' transform='rotate(-15 40 20)' fill='#e0b978'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='20' rx='3' ry='7' transform='rotate(15 56 20)' fill='#e0b978'/>
  <!-- face snout -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='38' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e8c68a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='1.8' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='30' r='1.8' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='37' rx='2' ry='1.2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <rect x='38' y='44' width='20' height='7' rx='3' fill='#e85a5a'/>
  <rect x='54' y='46' width='6' height='16' rx='2' fill='#d94a4a'/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <rect x='40' y='44' width='4' height='7' fill='#f7d34e'/>
  <rect x='48' y='44' width='4' height='7' fill='#f7d34e'/>
  <rect x='54' y='50' width='6' height='3' fill='#f7d34e'/>
  <rect x='54' y='56' width='6' height='3' fill='#f7d34e'/>
  <!-- tail fluff -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='64' r='5' fill='#e0b978'/>
</svg>
